doc.title: Sherrie Maricle interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 18, 2001 [interview 1 of 2]

title: Upcoming tours and recordings
summary: Plans a tour with Nancy Wilson, Tanglewood, and a live CD with Diane Schuur at the Manchester Craftsmen's Guild.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: Only five? That’s not enough. Well this has really been a fascinating conversation. I wish you all the best in the future.
And you’re going on tour coming up with any of your groups soon?

Yeah. We’re booking a tour with Nancy Wilson, actually with the big band. And our first concert is going to be at the Tanglewood jazz weekend this Labor Day. And we’re doing our fourth CD in May, a live CD, we’re doing five dates with Diana Schur at the Manchester Craftsman’s Guild, which is a phenomenal place in Pittsburgh, like very state-of-the-art audio/video recital hall. It’s an amazing, amazing place. And we’re going to record all five halves of our concert and hopefully we’ll get one good live CD out of it. So that’s our two big projects coming up.
Well I wish you luck in all that juggling.
I think it’s a good role model for people, that there’s lots of different ways to make a living in music and sometimes you have to do all of them. © Fillius Jazz Archive -21-
